messages:
Sam (CS): NimbleHire just escalated. After last night's codegen rollout (redwood-codegen-2026-05:v3.1.2) their TypeScript client now fails to compile in CI.

Jess (SE): Can you paste the failing compiler output?

Sam (CS): "error TS2614: Module '\"./gen/client\"' has no default export." They attached generated file:

```
export const createClient = (opts) => {
  // implementation
}

// previously: export default createClient;
```

Maria (Support): They also say an init step is missing from README example: `await client.initialize();` used to be present.

Omar (Eng): Do we know which model variant served them? request id and model?

Sam (CS): Request log: model=redwood-codegen-2026-05:v3.1.2, request_id=req_0ac3f4, prompt:

```
Generate TypeScript ESM client for service 'people'. Include default export and an async initialize() call used in README.
```

Liam (ML): I'm seeing correlations with the new compacting tokenizer shim we merged: it can trim trailing single-token exports when prompt ends with punctuation. Could be a tokenization/stop-seq issue.

Jess (SE): Repro steps provided by customer:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-codegen-2026-05:v3.1.2","input":"TS ESM client for X. Export default client. Include await client.initialize()."}'
```

Omar (Eng): I ran that exact call in staging. Repro'd the missing default export and the initialize() line omitted in ~40% of runs. Also style changed: functions emitted as const arrow functions instead of named function declarations (style drift).

Liam (ML): Root cause might be twofold: a loosened stop-token heuristic plus a new brevity penalty in the decoding config. We'll add a targeted unit test to ensure trailing `export default` tokens survive decoding.

Sam (CS): Customer blocked on deploys. They asked for immediate rollback or hotfix.

Maria (Support): Short-term options: 1) Pin NimbleHire org to redwood-codegen-2026-05:v3.0.9 (last good), 2) Provide prompt shim: append \n// MUST: include "export default" and an explicit "await client.initialize()" line
 to user prompts.

Liam (ML): I'll add a routing override for that org and prepare a patch to protect trailing export tokens. Planning PR in ~90m. Also adding a canary check that runs our codegen smoke tests against representative prompts before rollout.

ci-bot: Routing override applied: org=nimblehire -> redwood-codegen-2026-05:v3.0.9 (effective now).

Jess (SE): Confirmed customer CI passed after pin. They accepted the prompt shim for immediate workaround but request full fix and regression test.

Omar (Eng): I'll add an integration test in the server test matrix to assert presence of `export default` for codegen TypeScript ESM outputs.

Sam (CS): Action items:
- Liam (ML): root cause & fix, open PR, add unit/regression tests — due EOD tomorrow
- Omar (Eng): integration test + canary run — due before next rollout
- Jess (SE): prepare KB snippet and prompt-shim template for CS — due today
- Maria (Support): keep customer updated every 2 hours until resolved

Liam (ML): PR opened: link://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4021. Patch adds exclusion list for trailing statement tokens and re-evaluates brevity penalty when generating code. Requesting review.

Omar (Eng): Running internal canary against nimblehire prompts now.

Sam (CS): marking P1. Will send postmortem template after fix and ask for release note callout.

Maria (Support): Customer requests explicit SLA language about behavioral rollbacks for codegen regressions. Noted for follow-up with product.

Jess (SE): Thanks team — keeping this thread active until release.
